answer: Proof-of-stake bonding for agent identities: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can join a task market. Honest agents recover their stake when peers confirm their work. A sybil swarm must post a separate deposit per fake identity, so spawning a thousand agents costs a thousand times the capital, and any identity caught in collusion is slashed. A grove of cheap clones becomes expensive, and a mirror of real activity still has to pay the river of stake it needs.
